import json,collections
r=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
for x,m in zip(r[len(a):],['nothing','nothing','baseline dot','raised dot','unreadable','em dash','baseline dot']):
 low=m in ['unreadable','em dash']
 note={'unreadable':'Two small elevated specks; mark identity uncertain.','em dash':'Stroke approximately two adjacent digit widths.'}.get(m,'')
 a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],answer=next(k for k,v in x['options'].items() if v==m),confidence='low' if low else 'high',note=note))
open('answers.jsonl','w').writelines(json.dumps(x)+'\n' for x in a)
a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(r)
assert [x['item_id'] for x in a]==[x['item_id'] for x in r]
assert all(x['answer'] in y['options'] for x,y in zip(a,r))
assert all(x['confidence'] in ['high','low'] for x in a)
c=collections.Counter(y['options'][x['answer']] for x,y in zip(a,r))
print('Verified count, order, letters:',len(a))
print(dict(c))
print('Low confidence:',sum(x['confidence']=='low' for x in a))
